select q.id,q.question_type,cast(q.question_content as char) question_content, cast(q.answer_content as char) answer_content,cast(q.analysis_content as char) analysis_content, q.difficulty,q.status,q.created_at,q.updated_at, group_concat(distinct c.course_name order by c.id separator '、') course_names, group_concat(distinct concat(c.course_name,' / ',qc.stage_name) order by c.id,qc.stage_name separator '、') course_stage_names from exam_question q left join exam_question_course qc on qc.question_id=q.id left join sys_course c on c.id=qc.course_id
and q.question_type=#{req.questionType} and exists(select 1 from exam_question_course x where x.question_id=q.id and x.course_id=#{req.courseId}) and q.difficulty=#{req.difficulty}and q.status=#{req.status} and (q.question_content like concat('%',#{req.keyword},'%') or q.answer_content like concat('%',#{req.keyword},'%')) group by q.id order by q.id desc

select q.id,q.question_type,cast(q.question_content as char) question_content,cast(q.answer_content as char) answer_content,cast(q.analysis_content as char) analysis_content,q.difficulty,q.status,q.created_at,q.updated_at,group_concat(distinct c.course_name order by c.id separator '、') course_names,group_concat(distinct concat(c.course_name,' / ',qc.stage_name) order by c.id,qc.stage_name separator '、') course_stage_names from exam_question q left join exam_question_course qc on qc.question_id=q.id left join sys_course c on c.id=qc.course_id where q.id=#{id} group by q.id
